items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Targets 2027 Launch For A USD Stablecoin
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE: GS) and a consortium of 21 global banks plan to launch a USD stablecoin by 2027. The bank-led consortium aims to issue a regulated, USD-backed digital token distinct from any central bank digital currency. The group intends to use the stablecoin for cross-border payments, institutional settlements, and broader digital asset market activity.
